title: Upcoming Online Events – February 2021
html:
The first events in 2021 where you can watch Kamailio related presentations and interact with our community members are:

  • FOSDEM 2021 – February 6-7, 2021 – in the RTC Devroom there is a presentation about a new possible alternative that may be offered by Kamailio in the future for RTP relaying (now PR #2208), by Mojtaba Esfandiar. Besides that, Daniel-Constantin Mierla will do a presentation about small CLI tools that can be useful when developing and testing Kamailio or VoIP platforms.
  • ClueCon TGI 2021 – February 16-17, 2021 – Fred Posner has a presentation about services that can be outsourced from FreeSWITCH to Kamailio; and Daniel-Constantin Mierla will conduct a workshop “Kamailio – SIP Routing 101” and also present the session “Mastering DID Routing With Kamailio”.

The sessions for the both events can be watched online, from the comfort of your living room sofa or the office. Check the websites of the events for more specific details. With travelling restrictions world wide, the online events give now the chance to stay in contact with peers from the RTC industry and learn what is new in the space.

Stay safe and healthy!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
